Name: (FS) Jedone's Jersey Pack
Author: Jed0ne
Description:
[i][b][color=#a4c2f4][size=5][font=Arial Black]Jedone's Jersey Pack *☆+[/font][/size][/color][/b][/i]
[size=4][font=Trebuchet MS]Adds track tops and sleeves for Fashion Sense.[/font][/size]

[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][b]✪ Includes ✪[/b][/size][/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]- China Track Tops (8 colors)
- Basic Track Tops (8 colors)
- Jersey Sleeves (3 colors)[/size][/font]


[line]

[font=Trebuchet MS][b][size=5]✪ Installation ✪[/size][/b][/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]1. Ensure you have the latest version of the required mod installed ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense 7.5.0+[/url]).
2. Unzip and place the folder(s) into your 'Mods' folder.[/size][/font]

[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][b]✪ How to Wear ✪[/b][/size][/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]- Equip a top first, then equip matching sleeves.
- The sleeves are compatible with [b]Vanilla[/b] tops and [b]Fashion Sense tops.[/b]
- Feel free to mix and match the sleeves with other Fashion Sense tops![/size][/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]- Set Saturation and Lightness to 100 in the color slider to display the colors correctly.
- ⚠️ [b]Not compatible [/b]with tops added via [b]'JA'[/b] or[b] 'CP'.[/b][/size][/font]

[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][b]✪ Tips ✪[/b][/size]
[size=4]Use the [b]Author filter[/b] in Fashion Sense and search for [color=#9fc5e8]"Jedone"[/color] to find my items easily.[/size][/font]
